title: Bohairic Coptic New Testament
rights: CC BY 4.0 (Coptic SCRIPTORIUM; source text Marcion / Hany Takla).
citation: Bohairic New Testament. Coptic SCRIPTORIUM, version 6.0 (2024), from the Marcion edition (Hany Takla). CC BY 4.0.
editorialMarkers: The Bohairic dialect, the liturgical language of the Coptic Orthodox Church to this day. Tagging is the corpus’s; loanwords marked Greek or Hebrew are recorded as spans. Where this witness does not carry a verse — Acts 8:37 and Mark 9:46 among them, verses absent from most early manuscripts — the edition marks the place rather than dropping the verse, and Wellspring writes every such mark the same way, as “[—]”, so that the gap is visible and the numbering stays true. That marker is the edition’s own and is reproduced here unchanged: it means the verse is not in this manuscript tradition, not that the text is unknown.
method: Verse text is the corpus’s bound groups (orig_group / <phr>) joined with spaces; loanwords the corpus marks as Greek, Hebrew or Latin are kept as spans (sp.loan) for Word study; no normalisation of spelling.
